3.name: L
3.text: Welcome home! I’ve been waiting for you all day!

4.name: M
4.text: So sorry, you know how busy I am.

5.name: L
5.text: I know, I know, you’re my favorite hard worker.

6.name: L
6.text: Which reminds me, there's something important I needed to talk to you about.

9.name: L
9.text: So, you remember when I was talking about that chaotic situation at home, with my parents?

10.name: L
10.text: With that, we decided to move out.

12.name: L
12.text: From the city! We’re going back to my grandma's place for quite a while… Which is where you come in!

13.name: L
13.text: Do you want to come with me, babe?

17.name: L
17.text: But here's the thing… I can't come get you.

18.name: L
18.text: My parents are still finicky about our relationship, I can't convince them to go out of their way just to take you with us.

19.name: L
19.text: But I really want you here, at my side. So please…

20.name: L
20.text: Please, can you gather up some money and take the bus here?

21.name: L
21.text: It's going to be so much easier to vouch for you if you're here in person, you know?

23.name: L
23.text: We’re moving out next Monday, so… You should have the money by Saturday?

24.name: M
24.text: What if i can't get enough money?

26.name: L
26.text: If you can't do that, I’ll have to go without you.

27.name: L
27.text: I hate long-distance relationships, there's no passion.

28.name: L
28.text: We would talk normally for a while, and then we would slowly drift away…

29.name: L
29.text: If that was going to happen, I'd prefer we stop talking at once.

30.name: L
30.text: So, you're gonna have the money by then, right?

31.name: L
31.text: You want to stay with me forever, right?

34.name: L
34.text: I’ll stop bothering you now, get the money soon!
